claim: Model-only SF1.05 amplitudes .793/1.628/2.486 mm and unquoted costs reproduce; six coating corrections remain UNREVIEWED.
source_report_body: MAINLINE062 complete; QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. 047 is not admissible as a physical hull tolerance: finished-sheet compression, directional CR III crushing/unloading/mixed loading, processed bond and manufactured residual state remain unqualified. SR-200’s 290 GPa and light 2U film identity are sourced, with limits. Closed-form transfer of 057 bills gives cure-debited SF1.05 amplitudes 0.793/1.628/2.486 mm at R10/20/30; no FE sweep. Seven precedent records distinguish RMS, fit and maximum local defects. Candidate passive panel/jig/closure route has unquoted first-shell costs $66.5–477.4M/$522.8M–3.814B/$1.835–13.448B; full qualification costs remain open. Whole mass bills retain concept growth: all six cases have negative payload. Pins, arithmetic, stock takeoff and cost closure verified. Sixteen NFIs and REVIEW-A handoff included. No qualified cheapest route or P2 capacity released; no successor.
numerical_scope: Synthesis of attributed reports; consult named check/review findings for numerical disposition
qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma.
